name: 通义
desc: 通义助手应用，后更名千问
desc_zh: 通义助手应用，后更名千问
solves: Researching, reading pages and writing documents normally means switching between several tools. 通义 pulls them into a single chat box.
solves_zh: 查资料、读网页、做文档原本要切好几个工具。通义把它们收进一个对话框。
best_for: When you want to look things up and produce a document or slides in the same place.
best_for_zh: 你要一边查资料一边产出文档或演示稿。
notes: 官网 tongyi.com 已 301 跳转至 qianwen.com，通义并入千问；status/superseded_by 待合并时处理
